changed.title: Find a bounded nonlinear-depth selector exceeding the two-binomial-sum rank budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 ∧
    budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d) < A.rank

changed.title: Three unit-cost perfect matchings encode signed parity equations with a uniform distance bound
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (v m : ℕ) (ep : Fin m → Bool → Fin v) (rhs : Fin m → Bool),
  let X := Fin v → Bool
  let add := fun (a b : Bool) => decide (a ≠ b)
  let bad := fun (x : X) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Fin m =>
    add (x (ep e false)) (x (ep e true)) ≠ rhs e)).card
  let deg := fun (j : Fin v) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin m × Bool => ep p.1 p.2 = j)).card
  ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ C*(v+m) ∧
    let V := Bool × Fin n
    let Y := V → Bool
    ∃ (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (owner : Fin n → Fin v) (neg : Fin n → Bool)
      (dec : Y → X),
      (∀ j : Fin v,
        let pos := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => owner i = j ∧ neg i = false)).card
        let inv := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => owner i = j ∧ neg i = true)).card
        0 < pos ∧ pos = inv ∧ pos + inv ≤ C*(1+deg j)) ∧
      let enc := fun (x : X) (p : V) => add (x (owner p.2)) (neg p.2)
      let cost := fun (y : Y) =>
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,i))).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,σ i))).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) = y (true,τ i))).card
      (∀ x : X, dec (enc x) = x ∧ cost (enc x) = 2 * bad x) ∧
      ∀ y : Y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V => y p ≠ enc (dec y) p)).card +
        C*(2*bad (dec y)) ≤ C*cost y
